description: Shows which coding agents in the integrated terminals of this window are still working and which are done or waiting for you.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Profiles start programs: the profiles of a workspace that is not trusted are ignored.
container.title: Agents
view.sessions.name: Sessions
view.attention.name: Attention
command.focusNext: Focus the Agent That Needs Me
config.profiles: Agents that can be started from the **Agents** view, in addition to Claude Code (`claude`) and Codex (`codex`). A profile with the id `claude` or `codex` replaces the built-in one.
config.profiles.label: Name of the agent as the view shows it.
config.profiles.command: Command line that starts the agent. It runs in the shell of a new integrated terminal.
config.profiles.args: Arguments, each one quoted for the shell as needed.
config.profiles.cwd: Folder to start in. `${workspaceFolder}` is the workspace folder, which is also the default.
config.profiles.icon: Product icon of the terminal and the card, such as `sparkle`, `code`, `beaker`, `rocket`.
config.profiles.quietSeconds: An interactive agent that writes nothing for this many seconds is waiting for you. 0 never concludes that from silence.
config.profiles.matchCommand: Regular expression. A terminal in which a matching command line is started by hand becomes a session of this profile.
config.adoptCommands: Regular expression for command lines that make a terminal an agent session when no profile matches. It is tested against the command line without leading environment assignments and without the directory of the command. Empty adopts nothing.
config.notify: Controls the notification when an agent starts to wait for you, finishes or fails.
config.notify.attention: Notify unless the terminal of the agent is the active terminal of the focused window.
